g.text: Boxes summarize 48 trial conditions; the shared temporal basis and every kinematics-to-loading map are refit without the test trials.

text.style: font-size: 6.1px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6675

g.text: Neural targets are 38-dimensional factor trajectories from three newly retrained regional LFADS models (seed 760), not raw spike counts. Negative condition-wise values are clipped at zero only for display, matching the source figure convention.
